title: Good: spawn_blocking + Arc<PathBuf> pattern matches LMDB precedent
description: Using spawn_blocking for all file I/O with Arc<PathBuf> to cross the thread boundary is the established pattern (matches LmdbStore/LmdbBlockStore). A future contributor might suggest tokio::fs async file ops instead. Defend: tokio::fs internally uses spawn_blocking anyway, adds an extra level of abstraction, and makes the read/write code more complex. The explicit spawn_blocking pattern is more transparent about what it does.
